threadsSurface.title: Threads
threadsSurface.intro: Variables the game tells a story with: three values or more, set or checked at two places or more.
threadsSurface.noProjectWhy: Open a project and its threads appear here.
threadsSurface.noThreadsWhy: No variable has three values at two places.
threadsSurface.notAdopted: No threads: the scripts are not adopted.
threadsSurface.notAdoptedWhy: Without script sources the index cannot see which values scripts set and check.
threadsSurface.chooseOne: Choose a thread: its graph appears below, the places that set a value on the left, the places that check it on the right.

storiesSurface.title: Stories
storiesSurface.intro: Stories tell what happens in the game with a variable or a flag, step by step.
storiesSurface.noProjectWhy: Open a project and its stories appear here.
storiesSurface.noTextProjectWhy: Stories live as files in the text project; the DSPRE layout has none. Technical › Text project sets it up.
storiesSurface.setUpTextProject: Set up as a text project…
storiesSurface.noStoriesWhy: “New story…” creates one: a name and the variable or flag that holds its progress.
storiesSurface.chooseOne: Choose a story: its notes, its steps and its graph appear below.

storyDetail.noValues: No values in the game yet
storyDetail.noSteps: No steps yet. “Create step” creates them through recipes.
storyDetail.name: Name

deleteDialog.title: Delete story “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.text: The story's file, its layout and its registry entry go. Undo with ⌘Z.

newStoryDialog.title: New story
newStoryDialog.description: A story keeps its progress in a variable or a flag; its steps are created by the recipes.
newStoryDialog.name: Name

threadGraph.selectNode: Enter or Space selects a node.
threadGraph.selectEdge: Enter or Space selects an edge.
threadGraph.movable: Enter or Space selects a node; the arrow keys move the selected one, Shift moves it further.
threadGraph.moved: Node moved {{direction}}, now at x {{x}}, y {{y}}

storyRecipeModel.trainersTalk: Trainers speak through their battle texts
storyRecipeModel.needsVar: Recipes need a variable as progress

descriptions.talkAdvances: The character gets a conversation branch: from the chosen step on it says the text and moves the story on.
descriptions.figureAppears: The character appears or disappears from the chosen step on; a flag from the pool holds whether it is there.
descriptions.sceneOnEnter: Whoever enters the place at the chosen step sees the text; after that the story moves on.
descriptions.rewardOnce: From the chosen step on the character gives an item once; a flag from the pool remembers that it was given.

stepField.noStep: The story has no step yet.

recipeFields.hint: Enter: new line; Shift+Enter: new page (▼).

storyRecipeDialog.noVarStory: No story with a variable as progress yet.
storyRecipeDialog.chooseFirst: Once everything is chosen, what the recipe creates appears here.
